resources.name: Highlighter
resources.desc: Free Tool available from Fire/Mandiant that will depict log/text file that can highlight areas on the graphic, that corresponded to a key word or phrase. Good for time lining an infection and what was done post compromise.

resources.name: Morgue
resources.desc: PHP Web app by Etsy for managing postmortems.

resources.name: Plaso
resources.desc: a Python-based backend engine for the tool log2timeline.

resources.name: Timesketch
resources.desc: Open source tool for collaborative forensic timeline analysis.

resources.name: The Future of Incident Response
resources.desc: Presented by Bruce Schneier at OWASP AppSecUSA 2015.

resources.name: AChoir
resources.desc: Framework/scripting tool to standardize and simplify the process of scripting live acquisition utilities for Windows.

resources.name: Crowd Response
resources.desc: Lightweight Windows console application designed to aid in the gathering of system information for incident response and security engagements. It features numerous modules and output formats.

resources.name: DFIR ORC
resources.desc: DFIR ORC is a collection of specialized tools dedicated to reliably parse and collect critical artifacts such as the MFT, registry hives or event logs. DFIR ORC collects data, but does not analyze it: it is not meant to triage machines. It provides a forensically relevant snapshot of machines running Microsoft Windows. The code can be found on GitHub.

resources.name: FastIR Collector
resources.desc: Tool that collects different artifacts on live Windows systems and records the results in csv files. With the analyses of these artifacts, an early compromise can be detected.

resources.name: Fibratus
resources.desc: Tool for exploration and tracing of the Windows kernel.

resources.name: Hoarder
resources.desc: Collecting the most valuable artifacts for forensics or incident response investigations.

resources.name: IREC
resources.desc: All-in-one IR Evidence Collector which captures RAM Image, $MFT, EventLogs, WMI Scripts, Registry Hives, System Restore Points and much more. It is FREE, lightning fast and easy to use.

resources.name: Invoke-LiveResponse
resources.desc: Invoke-LiveResponse is a live response tool for targeted collection.

resources.name: IOC Finder
resources.desc: Free tool from Mandiant for collecting host system data and reporting the presence of Indicators of Compromise (IOCs). Support for Windows only. No longer maintained. Only fully supported up to Windows 7 / Windows Server 2008 R2.

resources.name: IRTriage
resources.desc: Incident Response Triage - Windows Evidence Collection for Forensic Analysis.

resources.name: KAPE
resources.desc: Kroll Artifact Parser and Extractor (KAPE) by Eric Zimmerman. A triage tool that finds the most prevalent digital artifacts and then parses them quickly. Great and thorough when time is of the essence.

resources.name: MEERKAT
resources.desc: PowerShell-based triage and threat hunting for Windows.

resources.name: Panorama
resources.desc: Fast incident overview on live Windows systems.

resources.name: PowerForensics
resources.desc: Live disk forensics platform, using PowerShell.

resources.name: PSRecon
resources.desc: PSRecon gathers data from a remote Windows host using PowerShell (v2 or later), organizes the data into folders, hashes all extracted data, hashes PowerShell and various system properties, and sends the data off to the security team. The data can be pushed to a share, sent over email, or retained locally.

resources.name: RegRipper
resources.desc: Open source tool, written in Perl, for extracting/parsing information (keys, values, data) from the Registry and presenting it for analysis.
